cells: recycleGPUResources: function recycleGPUResources(oldEnt: Entity, newEnt: Entity)

Recursively transfers heavy WebGPU buffers and pipeline caches from an old entity to a newly created entity. This prevents VRAM thrashing and GC pauses. Body operations (including nested callbacks): calls to `oldEnt.getComponent`, `newEnt.getComponent`, `key.toLowerCase().includes`, `key.toLowerCase`, `recycleGPUResources`; 2 explicit loops.
